audit.why: Disk chart (Skill, Shen, Shen, Skill, Skill, Shen, Shen) matches the packet chart and the 54.1% over 4052 games; full and content layers agree row for row.

Four spikes present and correctly timed: Shen Lvl 2-3, Lvl 6 Stand United, first item, and Sylas's late Hijack threat. Hijack itself scales hard — 80/55/30s — which is why the late spike belongs to him.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two systematic errors. (a) Every reference to Sylas's healing credits his Q — 'his Q-drain healing', 'his Q healing', 'his Q-W drain' — across whys[3], whys[5], spikes[2], early, mid and wants.foe[2]. Chain Lash (Q) does no healing at all; Kingslayer (W) is the lunge that heals. (b) Abscond / Abduct is described as 'his dash + stun (recast pull)' in breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, report[5].t and wants.foe[0] — the recast pulls Sylas to the target and applies no stun.
audit.why: Riot's kit text: Q Chain Lash slows and detonates, no heal, 10/9/8/7/6s. W Kingslayer 'lunges at an enemy... healing himself against enemy champions', 12/10.5/9/7.5/6s — flagged heal. E Abscond 'dashes to a location. Sylas can recast to throw his chains out, pulling himself to an enemy he hits' — flagged projectile and dash only, no hardCC flag and no stun in the description.
audit.corrected: All healing references reassigned to Kingslayer (W) with its 12s rank-1 cooldown; the E described as a dash that recasts into a self-pull, no stun.

audit.whatIsWrong: No real cooldowns anywhere, and breakdown.cooldowns tracks the wrong ability as the punishable one.
audit.why: Abscond / Abduct at 13s rank 1 is the gap-closer to bait, but Kingslayer at 12s is the ability that actually decides an extended trade, and Hijack collapsing from 80s to 30s is why the late game gets more dangerous, not less.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1] and late both warn that Sylas can 'interrupt the channel with Abscond / Abduct'. Nothing in Sylas's kit stuns or otherwise interrupts a channel — his only CC is the Chain Lash slow.
audit.why: The real reason to cast Stand United with vision of Sylas is Hijack copying it, not an interrupt. Telling a player to fear a non-existent interrupt makes them hold a 200s ultimate for no reason.

edits.before: - Sylas Abscond / Abduct: matchup-defining — His dash + stun (recast pull). Bait it, then commit. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Abscond / Abduct: 13s at rank 1 — his only gap-closer, so bait it and then commit. - Kingslayer: 12s, and it is where every point of his healing comes from. - Hijack: 80s at rank 1 but only 30s at rank 3 — the late game gets worse.

edits.before: At Level 1 you are both feeling each other out — Sylas has no real gap close yet, so abuse Twilight Assault to land your Q-empowered autos from behind the spirit blade and generate a Ki Barrier shield before he can respond. The moment you hit Level 2 and have Shadow Dash, the lane tilts your way: E-taunt him when his Abscond / Abduct is down, drop Spirit's Refuge between you to block his Petricite Burst auto storm, then pull the spirit blade through him with Q for the full damage shred. His Q-W drain can heal back a chunk, so end the trade quickly — do not let him sit inside your W zone and keep swinging after you have dealt your burst.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 continue to favour you as long as you respect the Abscond / Abduct cooldown — his E is his entire engage pattern, and if you burn it with a defensive E-taunt or simply sidestep it, he has no other way to stick to you. Start building Mercs or an early MR shard into your item path because all of his damage is magic and the longer fights go the more his Q drain closes the gap. At Level 6 Stand United is live and your primary job shifts: you are a global force now, not a lane bully. Keep scoring short trades to deny him CS and push him off the wave, then look for Stand United targets the moment he is distracted or committed to a fight — the game around the map is where this matchup is actually won.

edits.before: By two items the lane has long passed and Sylas becomes a teamfight menace — if he has your Stand United stolen in a large skirmish, your own team teleports in reinforcements for him, which is devastating. Always confirm Sylas's position on the minimap before channeling R: cast it only when he is visibly engaged on someone else or too far away to interrupt the channel with Abscond / Abduct. Your Sunfire-Hollow Radiance tank core lets you frontline and absorb his magic damage while your team collapses, and the sustained empowered-auto pressure from Twilight Assault in prolonged fights keeps your presence threatening even without a cooldown rotation.

notes: The packet reported zero defects and zero suspectNames for this matchup, yet the page mis-credited Sylas's entire healing package to his Q in six separate fields and invented a stun on his E in four more.
